facts.fact: Minister Leon Schreiber demonstrated a working MyMzansi digital ID credential issued through the population register, but gave no public date; the annual performance plan targets hosting by 31 March 2027 and citizen credentials in a mobile wallet in 2027/2028.

ZAF.note: Only plans to automate birth registration; no register link stated.
No count of people enrolled given.
Birth registration plans mention no ID number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the system in service.
No register stated as keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: The physical smart ID card is available, with 515 bank branches already offering walk-in smart ID replacements, and it will remain available beside the digital ID.
